seo.seo_title: About us, a student company from Boden | Norden Media UF
seo.seo_description: Norden Media UF is run by students at Björknäsgymnasiet in Boden. We build websites and live stream events, with one contact person all the way.

page_header.t4: Norden Media UF builds websites and live streams events. We are students at Björknäsgymnasiet in Boden and run the business as a student company in partnership with Ung Företagsamhet (Junior Achievement Sweden). We take care of the tech, so that our clients can spend their time on their business.

hur_vi_tanker.t21: We take responsibility for the tech, so you never have to worry about it.
hur_vi_tanker.t23: A fixed price, and no invoice until you have approved the result.
hur_vi_tanker.t25: We explain things in plain language, not tech-speak.
hur_vi_tanker.t27: We stay on after launch and keep improving what works.

after_the_uf_year.t31: A UF student company runs for one school year, but working with us does not have to end there. Our plan is to continue the business as a limited company, with the same people and the same service, for every client who wants to stay.
after_the_uf_year.t32: The website and all its content belong to you.
after_the_uf_year.t33: If you would rather move on, we hand over all the material and help you move to another provider, so the switch is smooth.
